question: What rate would someone with a 15% deposit get?
reply:
A 15% deposit means an LVR of 85%, which falls in the 80.01% to 90% band on the Example Basic Home Loan variable rate table (examplelender.com.au, read 13 Oct 2026). That band shows an interest rate of 6.44% p.a., comparison rate 6.47% p.a. The monthly fee cell for that band is blank in the document, so no fee is shown.

Note: this was read today, so the rate should be current, but reading the page again later will confirm if it's changed.
